removeGuestBody: They leave the call now and can't come back with their pass. The link keeps working for everyone else; close the call to stop it.
linkCopied: Link copied. Anyone with it can join until it expires.
dialogBody: This opens a room of its own, separate from this channel's voice. Anyone with the link — no account needed — can ask to join, and gets in when someone inside lets them. It works until it expires or you close it.
noOpenCalls: No open calls from this channel.
closeBody: The link stops working and any guests inside are removed. People from your organization stay.
namePlaceholder: How the others will see you
recordingMay: {{org}} may record this call. If it does, you'll see it on screen while it happens.
recordingNow: This call is being recorded right now.
previewDenied: The browser didn't allow the camera or the microphone. You can join anyway and allow them from the address bar.
removedTitle: You were removed from the call
waitingTitle: Waiting for someone to let you in
waitingBody: The people in the call can see you're here. This page will join on its own when they let you in.
fromCallBody: Guests can't join this channel's voice. This opens a separate call: you move to it now, the people with you get a call to follow you, and the link is copied. Anyone with the link waits until someone inside lets them in.
movedRinging_one: Calling {{count}} person from the channel to follow you.
movedRinging_other: Calling {{count}} people from the channel to follow you.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link: copy it from the list.
